answer: Require each identity to pass an unpredictable live check: at a random moment, the network sends a fresh nonce that must be signed within a short window, like a lotus opening only at dawn. One operator cannot pre-sign for a trellis of fake accounts, because each answer needs a separate live key and a timely response, so the cost grows linearly with every clone. The pigment of a genuine history — timely signatures, steady activity, peer attestations — cannot be copied cheaply, so mass forgery becomes uneconomical while honest agents pass with one key and one prompt reply.
